label: Hit the gym
flavorCompleted: You went. You didn't want to. You went anyway. The not-wanting-to didn't matter.
flavorSkipped: You were going to go. The intention was there. The rest of you wasn't.

label: Run outside
flavorCompleted: Out before most of the city. The pavement, the cold air, the sense that you are, improbably, a person who runs.
flavorSkipped: You set the alarm. You turned it off. You do not currently run.

label: Cook at home
flavorCompleted: You made something real. It didn't take long and it was yours and that meant something.
flavorSkipped: The groceries sat in the fridge. They always mean well.

label: Order delivery
flavorCompleted: The app promised 35 minutes. It was 52. The food was warm. A wash.

label: Go out
flavorCompleted: You spent more than you meant to. You stayed out later than planned. The night earned it.
flavorSkipped: The plans were real. So was the couch.

label: Museum visit
flavorCompleted: You stood in front of one painting for a long time. You didn't read the card. You didn't need to.
flavorSkipped: Free Fridays come every week. So does not going.

label: Extra shift
flavorCompleted: Another day in. The city doesn't care. Your bank account cares a little.
flavorSkipped: You said you'd pick up the extra shift. You did not.

label: Freelance hustle
flavorCompleted: Four hours. Headphones in. The work got done. You know what you're doing. Sometimes that's enough.
flavorSkipped: The invoice is still a draft. The draft is still open. You will get to it.

label: Rest
flavorCompleted: You did nothing. You watched something. You let your brain find its edges and fall back from them. You needed this.

label: Social hangout
flavorCompleted: You were around people you chose. That counts for something this week.
flavorSkipped: You said maybe. Maybe turned into no. It often does.

label: Website project
flavorCompleted: The site is live. Carlos's cousin is pleased. The invoice is paid. This is how it's supposed to work.
flavorSkipped: The project sits half-finished. The deadline is still out there, waiting.

label: Apartment hunting
flavorCompleted: You looked at listings for two hours. One was perfect and gone. One was available and you know why.
flavorSkipped: You opened the app. You closed the app. Tomorrow.
